item.title: Slash Commands 1.0.2
item.description:
## What's New in 1.0.2
### Bug Fixes - Fixed a bug where selecting a command in the sidebar did not update the detail pane, leaving the previous command's trigger, body, and tags visible.
### Architecture - Decomposed the AppModel god class into focused sub-models (CommandManager, SettingsManager, PermissionManager, UpdateManager, DoctorManager) with dependency injection through AppContainer. - Decomposed RuntimeCoordinator from 1178 to 643 lines by extracting probes and matching into dedicated modules. - Decomposed CommandEditorView from 2399 to 715 lines by extracting policies and view models. - Extracted SettingsViewModel to decouple settings editing from AppModel. - Decoupled MainWindowScene, MenuBarExtraView, and SetupWindowPresenter from direct AppModel access. - Consolidated 9 runtime probe files into Runtime/Probes/ and expansion feedback helpers into UI/Expansion/. - Removed inline `#if DEBUG` blocks from EventTapManager decision logic.
